decisions.reason: As a flagship digital product line closely tied to the firm’s core practice management and regulatory workflow knowledge, its strong absorptive capacity supports ongoing learning and improvement, so keep with low drop probability.

Although it builds on existing training content, the continuing education institute requires distinct educational and regulatory capabilities that the firm lacks, and its weak website presence signals limited absorptive capacity and poor early results, so drop now.
The remote screen sharing support tool directly leverages the firm’s existing support and integration capabilities, enabling it to assimilate feedback and maintain the product effectively, so keep.

The practice performance analytics dashboard builds on the firm’s existing practice data and software engineering knowledge, giving it the absorptive capacity to interpret and improve the product, so keep.
As a repackaging of existing offerings into a complete bundle, it is closely aligned with the firm’s established product knowledge and can be readily managed, so keep.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm’s core software and service knowledge, limiting its ability to recognize and apply relevant market information, and its absence from the website indicates weak results, so drop.
